settings.statusReady: This device can read and send end-to-end encrypted messages.
settings.statusLocked: Locked: approve this device from another one, or enter your recovery code.
settings.intro: Direct messages and group chats are end-to-end encrypted once everyone in them uses an up-to-date DeCave: only the people in the conversation can read them, not DeCave. Your devices share one key, which changes every month. Keep your recovery code somewhere safe: without it or another signed-in device, encrypted history can't be recovered.
settings.newRecoveryCodeFailed: Could not create a new recovery code.
settings.historyHelp: Shorter means a stolen device or recovery code can read less of your past. Older encrypted messages become unreadable on all your devices. The other person's devices follow their own setting.
settings.historyConfirm: Encrypted messages older than {{period}} will become unreadable on all your devices. This can't be undone. Continue?

recovery.title: Save your recovery code
recovery.intro: Your direct messages are now end-to-end encrypted. This code is the only way to read them on a new device when none of your other devices is around. DeCave can't show it again or recover it for you.
recovery.savedConfirm: I saved it somewhere safe, like a password manager.

unlock.title: Unlock encrypted messages
unlock.intro: This device doesn't have your encryption key yet. Approve it from the DeCave app on your phone (or another device that's signed in right now), or use your recovery code.
unlock.askFailed: Could not ask your other devices.
unlock.compareCode: Approve this on your other device and check that it shows the same code:
unlock.lostEverything: Lost every device and your code?

reset.title: Reset encryption key?
reset.intro: A new key replaces the old one. Encrypted messages sent before now can no longer be read on any device, your other devices will need to be unlocked again, and the people you talk to will see that your security code changed.

safety.title: End-to-end encryption
safety.intro: Messages with {{name}} are end-to-end encrypted. To be sure nobody is in the middle, compare this security code with the one {{name}} sees, in person or on a call.
safety.peerNotSetUp: {{name}} hasn't set up encryption yet, so messages with them are stored readable by DeCave.
safety.unlockToSee: Unlock encrypted messages on this device to see the security code.

approve.title: Approve a new device?
approve.intro: {{device}} wants to read your encrypted messages. Only approve it if you just signed in there and it shows this code:
